treatment_summary.value: Antiepileptic medication and early psychosocial intervention from age 4 (specialised schools); lamotrigine 75 mg bd at referral (age 22). Escitalopram up-titrated 10 to 70 mg od: moderate improvement of obsessional slowness, psychomotor retardation and motor rituals (Y-BOCS 33 to 24 over 18 months). Adjuncts risperidone 0.5 mg od, methylphenidate 5 mg od, mirtazapine 7.5 mg od added cumulatively: no benefit, discontinued (extrapyramidal side effects; agitation and social withdrawal; hypersomnolence). Conservative and non-pharmacologic therapies trialled. Lorazepam 1 mg bd at age 25 improved anxiety. Pramipexole hydrochloride 0.25 to 0.5 mg bd: significant improvement of obsessional slowness, motor initiation and psychomotor speed; higher doses increased anxiety and agitation.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Diagnosed at 12 years following the diagnosis of her younger brother; confirmed via urinary organic acid quantification, with elevated 4-hydroxybutyric acid and 4,5-dihydroxy hexanoic lactone levels. Genotyping was not performed.
